problem.title: Wildcard Matching
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters
p contains only lowercase English letters, '?' or '*'

operators.*: matches any sequence of characters, including the empty sequence

problem.match_rule: the match must cover the entire input string

acceptance_snapshot.total_submissions_note: The page shows a rounded total (about 2.9M); no exact total was recorded, so none is shown in the video.
acceptance_snapshot.note: Snapshot read from the LeetCode problem page on the check date; it changes continuously. These count submissions, not people. The video states this and shows the date.

educational_answer.time_complexity: O(m*n) worst case (1,002,001 loop iterations measured at n=2000); about 0.6 iterations per text character on 40 seeded random cases
educational_answer.strategy: Two pointers; remember only the most recent '*' and the text position it has swallowed up to; on a mismatch, backtrack to that star and let it swallow one more character
